plugin.name: DSH Controlled Plugin Updater
plugin.summary: Inspect plugins and update one selected package through a recoverable transaction

problem: Plugin versions and sources are difficult to inspect and update consistently.
trigger: The user selects one plugin, reviews a fresh plan, and enters the exact confirmation phrase.

outcome.expectedResult: The plugin starts read-only and can update one explicitly selected plugin with backup, health checks, and rollback after separate confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Read-only inventory works without changing the Profile.
Transaction fault tests reject stale hashes, reuse, and concurrent changes.
Disposable Profile update and rollback pass at E3.
Real Profile remains unchanged until a new exact operation plan is confirmed.

write: one selected package through official DSH CLI

ui.notes: Separate read-only discovery, plan review, and exact confirmation.

profile.restartOwner: approved external supervisor or manual user action

privacy: never log secrets or full Profile files
compatibility: fail closed on unknown official components
